items.cold_note: Exp 2 Liquid L = 5.0 cm
items.fact_error: Shared passage sc9a-p5 (whole passage): Exp 1 uses four cylinders of the SAME solid plastic, each 10.0 cm tall with 20.0 cm2 area (volume 200 cm3), but with masses 75, 150, 225 and 300 g. A homogeneous solid of fixed volume has one mass (m = rho V); four masses imply densities 0.375-1.5 g/cm3 for one material. A uniform floating cylinder also sinks to depth = h x rho_solid/rho_liquid, independent of mass, so the depth-proportional-to-mass trend in Table 1 cannot come from solid cylinders of one plastic. Exp 2's '150 g cylinder of the same solid plastic' inherits it.
